data.long_meaning: Harfaat is an Arabic name derived from the root h-r-f, which means 'to be gentle or kind'. In Islamic context, Harfaat symbolizes a person who is kind, compassionate, and merciful. The name Harfaat carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Harfaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
